pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. ALL / EVERYTHING: six solid colored circles red blue yellow green orange purple gathered together within ONE thin red oval, entire set included, no circle outside oval. Single red arrow points to whole group. Flat solid fills dark outlines, no letters, words, numerals or people. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
